title: The chat session is rebuilt on object identity, silently wiping the conversation mid-chat
detail: The effect depends on [book, summary, onAiError]. summary is an object from BookDetail's props; generating a deep-dive calls onSummaryUpdate, which produces a new Summary reference, which recreates the Chat. The user's in-progress conversation context is discarded while the on-screen transcript stays, so subsequent replies answer as if the earlier turns never happened.

title: A stream that fails after emitting text shows a truncated reply and no error
detail: The catch only rewrites the last message when entry.text === ''. If the model streamed a partial answer and then the connection dropped, the condition is false, the error message is discarded, and the user is left with a sentence that stops mid-thought and no indication anything went wrong.

title: User message bubbles are unreadable in dark mode
detail: The bubble flips to dark:bg-gray-900 but the text stays text-gray-800 with no dark pairing. The avatar chip beside it (bg-gray-200, line 146) is also light-only.

title: Closing the drawer mid-stream does not cancel the request
detail: There is no AbortController and no unmount guard, so a closed chat keeps consuming the stream and calling setState on a dead component.

title: A failed Goodreads import reports nothing at all
detail: handleImport has try/finally with no catch, and is invoked as void handleImport(). If importGoodreadsRows rejects — a quota-exceeded IndexedDB write on a 300-book import is the obvious case — the spinner stops, the modal stays open, no toast appears and no books are added. The user has no way to tell success from failure.

title: Re-selecting the same file after an error does nothing
detail: The input's value is never reset, so choosing the identical file a second time fires no change event. After a parse failure the obvious recovery — pick the file again — is silently inert.

title: The preview does not mention that every book will land in the 'Other' category
detail: The Bookshelves column is never parsed, so all imported books get category 'Other', collapsing the topic filter, the category breakdown and the Knowledge Topography panel. The preview reports counts and skips but not this.

title: The whole CSV is read into memory with no size guard
detail: await file.text() on an arbitrarily large user-picked file, then a full parse, all on the main thread.
